svg.title: The test engine survives late bytes after a compressed request body: A compressed JSON value remains valid when late trailing bytes arrive
svg.text: The test engine survives late bytes after a compressed
Scenario: A compressed JSON value remains valid when late trailing bytes arrive

g.text: Given the test engine has a regression for late compressed request bytes
The real parser receives a valid gzip frame and then invalid trailing bytes after parsing
finishes. Assertions check that the accepted value is preserved and the entire request stream
ends. An uncaught decoder error must fail the regression.
Then the installed test engine survives the late compressed request bytes
The task runs the real parser in a child process and requires exit code zero, accepted JSON and consumed trailing bytes.
Only measured execution times are hidden.
